card.name: Just before antifungal drug names
card.fires_on: Punctuation, linking words or word starts right before an antifungal drug or the word antifungal, such as a colon after Antifungals or 'of' before micafungin. It also fires on the start of antifungal words.

modes.label: Colon after antifungals
modes.description: A colon or comma after the word Antifungals introducing a list of azole drugs.

modes.description: A small word like of, to, with or an open bracket just before an antifungal drug or fungus name.
